status: Post-hoc ablation proposed after observing clean comparison results, before calculating veto-only results
hypothesis: The neural estimate is useful to detect doubt but its systematic error may worsen coordinates when averaged. Preserve fixed-5500 Burg coordinates and use neural agreement only as a veto.
rule: Exactly the same accepted/rejected points as cross_method_fixed; return burg5500 f1/f2 unchanged. No new thresholds or target labels.
data: Saved clean and stress predictions from the five-method comparison, with identical acoustic labels and exclusions
metrics: Same coverage, absolute errors, large-error definition and good-measurement yield as original experiment. Compare fixed averaging versus veto on identical points.
limitations: Post-hoc exploratory method selection. No independent validation and no evidence of learning. Stress copies reuse speakers and words.
